jobs.occupation: Senior Expert Group Controlling & Performance Management (m/w/d) (Controller/in)
jobs.description:
IRS Group

Financial Modelling, Data & Decision Support | IRS Gruppe | Holding | Hamburg | Immediate start preferred

For IRS Group, a fast-growing, internationally operating platform organisation backed by private equity, we are looking for an experienced **Senior Expert Group Controlling & Performance Management (m/f/d) **to join us at the earliest opportunity.

This is a hands-on expert role for someone who enjoys working with financial data, building practical models and turning analysis into clear business decisions. You will work closely with the management team, Group Controlling, BI, IT and our local country teams.

You will not have direct people-management responsibility. Instead, you will take ownership of your topics, coordinate stakeholders and drive projects from the initial idea through to implementation.

This is not a pure reporting position. You will help us improve the way we plan, analyse and manage the business across countries and locations.

Your responsibilities

- Further develop Group Controlling, management reporting and performance management
- Build and improve financial models for planning, forecasting, scenarios and business steering
- Analyse the main drivers of revenue, costs, margins, cash flow and working capital
- Turn financial and operational data into clear recommendations and practical actions
- Develop useful KPIs and reporting structures that improve transparency and comparability across countries and locations
- Work with BI and IT to improve the quality and consistency of our data
- Help ensure that data from operational systems, ERP systems, LucaNet and management reporting is consistent
- Lead controlling, reporting, data and process-improvement projects independently
- Prepare clear analyses, business cases and decision papers for management and the Holding
- Develop, maintain and further improve management reports in Power BI

What you bring

- Several years of relevant experience in Group Controlling, FP&A, Financial Modelling, Corporate Finance or a similar role
- Experience working in an international organisation or across different countries
- A solid understanding of the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital and operational business drivers
- Practical experience with budgeting, forecasting, business planning, scenario analysis and management reporting
- The ability to turn complex business topics into understandable financial models and clear management information
- Strong Power BI skills and the ability to develop and maintain reports independently
- A high level of interest in data and systems; experience with LucaNet, SAP, SQL, data warehouses or data engineering is an advantage
- Experience coordinating projects and working with different stakeholders across functions and countries
- The ability to work independently, set priorities and bring topics to completion
- Very good English orGerman skills

What is important to us

We are looking for someone who wants to make things better and delivers high-quality results.

You are comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy and taking responsibility for your work. You structure complex topics, communicate clearly and reliably, and are able to explain financial matters to both finance and non-finance colleagues.

You combine analytical skills with a practical, hands-on approach. You do not stop at identifying issues — you help define solutions and support their implementation. During busy periods, you are willing to take on additional responsibility and act as a dependable sparring partner for management.

What we offer

- A central and highly visible role in the further development and professionalisation of Group Controlling
- Direct collaboration with the Executive Board, management, Group Controlling, and relevant BI, IT, and local management teams — without direct line-management responsibility
- Significant scope to shape financial modelling, reporting, planning, data management, and performance steering
- An international platform organisation with around 170 locations
- A dynamic transformation environment with short decision-making processes and high visibility of your work and results
- An attractive compensation package reflecting the level of seniority, responsibility, and performance expectations
- An attractive overall package, including hybrid working opportunities
- Corporate benefits, including discounts of up to 50% at more than 1,500 brands
- Company bike

Contact

If you have strong controlling and Power BI experience and enjoy improving structures, data and decision-making, we would be pleased to hear from you — even if your experience does not match every point listed above.

IRS Holding GmbH
Eidelstedter Platz 18
22523 Hamburg

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As an Expert Business Partner (f/m/d), you will be a key finance business partner within the TI Compression Business Controlling team. You will take a leading role in orchestrating forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and preliminary actuals across the organization. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior management, you will ensure financial transparency, challenge business performance, and provide actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the consolidation, validation, and submission of forecasts while steering monthly reporting, preliminary actuals, and quarterly closing activities
* Lead and coordinate annual budgeting and long-term financial planning processes across multiple entities and stakeholders
* Own the analysis of actuals, forecasts, budgets, and prior-period results, identifying key business drivers, variances, risks, and opportunities
* Challenge and translate financial results into actionable business insights and develop compelling narrative reporting for senior management
* Act as a strategic finance partner to Controllers, Business Departments, Functional Stakeholders, and CP Management, including interaction with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Drive global continuous improvements across planning, reporting, data quality, and forecasting accuracy while leading cross-functional and international initiatives

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
* Significant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Business Controlling, or Corporate Finance, ideally gained in medium-sized to large international organizations; M&A experience is a plus
* Strong international and cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to lead and influence stakeholders across functions, entities, and cultures
* Strong understanding of financial statements, business drivers, and performance metrics, ideally gained in a manufacturing, industrial, or project-driven environment
* Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills, with proven experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders up to C-level
* Professional proficiency in English, both written and verbal

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing 
electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We 
enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, 
building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and 
integrated execution capabilities

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Principal Engineer (f/x/m) (DevOps Engineer)
jobs.description:
spotixx is a Frankfurt-based European FinTech building technology for the regulated financial sector. Since 2019, we have grown into a team of 60+ professionals with deep roots in the German and European banking landscape, shaped by years of hands-on experience in fraud investigation and financial crime prevention. We specialize in Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and fraud detection, enabling secure, compliant data exchange between financial institutions. Using advanced data science and AI, we are helping shift the industry toward collaborative intelligence and more effective prevention. As a self-funded company, we focus on sustainable growth and real impact. With offices in Frankfurt and Wilhelmshaven and strong inbound demand, we are expanding our team. If you want to work on meaningful problems, grow with the company, and be part of a flexible, hybrid work environment, spotixx offers the opportunity to do just that.

Tasks

- Take ownership of the platform's systems design, including the architecture, data models, contracts, and integration boundaries, and the trade-offs behind them.
- Stay hands-on through the highest-risk parts of the build, and ship code the team learns from.
- Set the design standard: the architectural, security, and verification patterns the team builds to, and the design reviews that uphold them.
- Design for security and scale, building systems that withstand banking-grade load and scrutiny.
- Raise the technical output of the team through direction, design review, and pairing.
- Build AI leverage: agentic workflows with the evals and guardrails needed to ship reliably.
- Represent us technically with customers, including workshops and due diligence with bank architects, CISOs, and risk teams, in German and English.
- Partner with senior management and your manager on strategy and prioritisation.

Requirements

- A deeply experienced, hands-on technologist, typically with 8+ years building production software, able to own systems design and still ship code others learn from.
- Fluent in German and English, both essential for our engagement with German banks.
- Large-enterprise context: you have delivered systems inside a large corporate or for a vendor supplying one, and understand how enterprise architecture reviews, security assessments, and change control work.
- Excellent systems design skills, covering distributed systems, services, contracts, data, and integrations.
- AI-forward: you already use coding agents and AI-assisted building in your own work or personal projects.
- A track record of raising the engineers around you through influence, design review, and example.
- Senior-management maturity: you translate technical risk into terms the business can act on.
- Credible and calm when bank architects and risk functions question design choices.
- Security-minded: secure-by-design thinking, OAuth/OIDC, and data protection appropriate to banking.
- Rigorous about quality: you design for verifiability and verify rather than assume.
- Regulated-industry experience, with banking or FinTech a major bonus.
- Cloud experience: GCP preferred, with AWS or Azure also welcome, plus familiarity with IaC, containers, and CI/CD.
- Nice to have: Python/FastAPI, React/TypeScript, the GCP stack, privacy-enhancing technology or applied cryptography (MPC especially), multi-tenant SaaS, and the anti-financial-crime domain.

Benefits

Attractive compensation.

Flexible hybrid work model (Frankfurt + home office within Germany).

High ownership and real impact from day one.

Flat structures that let the team move quickly.

️ Collaborative, international team culture.

Work on high-impact products that help fight financial crime.

‍♀️ Own the architecture of our core data-sharing platform and build it hands-on.

jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer Exploration, Space Safety and Space Transportation (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Analysis of customer-, mission- and system requirements, including support of a functional analysis, definition of a specification tree and identification of proposed adaptations
- Flowdown of requirements to subsystem and equipment level using DOORS
- Support to trade-offs, analysis and definition of mission- and system architecture
- Contribution to the definition and design of space systems including mission- and system design, analyses and design of entire space systems, subsystems and their specifications
- Contribution to interface and budget management of respective domain
- Technical coordination of subsystems and internal projects (e.g. impact investigation for requirements changes)
- Technical coordination of subcontractors by order of the Project Chief Engineer and / or the Project Manager

jobs.occupation: Business Controller (f/m/d) (Vertriebscontroller/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Business Controller (f/m/d) within the TI CP Business Controlling team, you serve as a trusted advisor to the Compression Service Region Europe & Africa, supporting a business spanning more than 35 countries. Working closely with regional leadership, finance teams, and operational stakeholders, you provide transparency on financial performance, drive forecasting and budgeting processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across a dynamic and diverse business environment.

Beyond core business controlling, you contribute to key strategic initiatives, including Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), sustainability reporting, central function controlling, and high-impact transformation projects. By combining financial expertise with business acumen and cross-functional collaboration, you help drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation across the region.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Acting as the primary Finance Business Partner for the Compression Service Europe & Africa management team, providing financial transparency and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
* Leading regional forecasting, budgeting, financial performance reviews, and financial planning & analysis activities across a network of more than 35 countries while identifying risks and opportunities
* Strengthening the Enterprise Risk Management framework and partnering with sustainability teams to support ESG initiatives, including EU Taxonomy reporting and compliance requirements
* Providing financial governance and controlling support for central functions, ensuring cost transparency, effective resource allocation, and sound financial governance
* Leading and supporting strategic projects and transformation initiatives, delivering financial insights, business case analyses, and value-creating recommendations
* Promoting process harmonization, digitalization, and automation to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making capabilities

What You Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is considered an advantage
* Proven experience in controlling, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or finance leadership within an international environment
* Strong expertise in forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, variance analysis, performance management, and financial governance, ideally complemented by knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management, ESG, or sustainability reporting
* Proven analytical and strategic capabilities with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations and influence management decisions
* Hands-on experience with SAP, financial planning systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office, combined with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills in multicultural organizations
* Fluent English skills; additional language skills are considered an advantage 

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
